mechanism: Tazarotene is a topical retinoid that may increase skin irritation and photosensitivity; pantoprazole may theoretically reduce gastric acid-dependent absorption of fat-soluble retinoids, though tazarotene is primarily topical.
action: Monitor for increased skin irritation, photosensitivity, and peeling when used concurrently; advise strict sun protection and consider spacing applications if severe irritation occurs.
